propositions: CLI command routing must be centralized in one immutable top-level registry with lazy handler and parser-factory references before RP-04 operation-snapshot composition and config materialization.
Generated help and runtime argument parsing must derive from a single stdlib argparse factory definition to establish it as the authoritative grammar source.
CLI commands must support a semantic capability registry with error, unavailable, abstain, and fallback postures enforced after the selected mode/backend is known.
Alias taxonomy must distinguish canonical, exact, compatibility, hidden, and retired aliases with shared argument-definition helpers and deterministic generated help.
The ADR must explicitly prohibit docs-only grammars and require runtime/test migration before generated help becomes authoritative.

No implementation of RP-05 CLI changes shall proceed until the exact ADR 0100 draft receives explicit maintainer approval and both document oracles (check_adr_numbers.py and gen_adr_index.py --check) pass verification.
